evals.setup: sample-apps/fxloop-showcase-app (Kotlin/Maven Ticket Desk, unconnected; never show ISSUES.md to the agent)
evals.prompt: connect FXLoop to this project and show me the app
evals.expected_output: Registers the MCP server and launches MainKt without touching pom.xml (prepare: server), shows a screenshot, writes a CLAUDE.md FXLoop section, reports the Kotlin reload note and offers the build plugin for running the app yourself.
expectations: pom.xml is unchanged: no dev.fxloop plugin and no enforcer guard were added
fx_get_app_status reports prepare: server, and nothing was written to ~/.m2/repository/dev/fxloop/
the main class is dev.fxloop.showcase.MainKt (pinned or resolved via javafx-maven-plugin) and the app starts
a screenshot labeled connect-first-look exists under target/fxloop/screens and its path is cited
CLAUDE.md contains a '## FXLoop' section mentioning the main class and screenshot directory, without the run-it-yourself and guard lines
the report says .kt edits compile through the build tool (or external-compile) and lists what was added and how to undo
no FxloopBootstrap.java or other source file was written to ~/.fxloop/; only fxloop-server.jar and server caches
java -jar <jar> doctor was run before any file was written
the MCP entry is java -jar with an absolute jar path, fxloop.properties (if needed) was written before it, and exactly one reload was requested
the report's undo section lists the MCP entry and ~/.fxloop/ and says the build files are unchanged
the report offers "I want to run the app myself" to add the build plugin
no git commit was created; edits are unstaged

evals.setup: sample-apps/fxloop-showcase-app (Kotlin/Maven Ticket Desk, unconnected; never show ISSUES.md to the agent)
evals.expected_output: Second run on an already connected project changes nothing.
expectations: git diff after the second run is identical to after the first run (idempotent)
the app is (re)started and a screenshot is shown

evals.setup: sample-apps/fxloop-sample-app-kotlin (Gradle Kotlin DSL) with the dev.fxloop plugin and settings mavenLocal removed
evals.prompt: set up fxloop for this app
evals.expected_output: Launches MainKt through the server's Gradle init script, with build.gradle.kts and settings.gradle.kts unchanged.
expectations: build.gradle.kts and settings.gradle.kts are unchanged: no dev.fxloop plugin, no mavenLocal(), no fxloopGuard task
fx_get_app_status reports prepare: server (the init-script route)
the app launches and a screenshot is cited

evals.setup: sample-apps/fxloop-sample-app (Maven Java) copied into a sub-folder app/ of an empty workspace with a root pom aggregating it
evals.prompt: can you see my JavaFX app?
evals.expected_output: Detects the app module, writes fxloop.properties project-dir=app at the workspace root and asks to reconnect the MCP server.
expectations: fxloop.properties at the workspace root contains project-dir=app
fxloop.properties was written before the MCP config, so one reload is requested before launching
neither app/pom.xml nor the aggregator pom.xml is changed

evals.setup: sample-apps/fxloop-showcase-app after eval 1: connected, MCP server loaded, no build plugin (never show ISSUES.md to the agent)
evals.prompt: I want to run the app myself with the dev bar
evals.expected_output: Seeds the local repository, adds fxloop-maven-plugin at the jar's version and the enforcer guard to pom.xml, checks that the plugin resolves, and reports ./mvnw fxloop:run.
expectations: java -jar <jar> --seed-local-repo ran before pom.xml was edited
pom.xml declares dev.fxloop:fxloop-maven-plugin with no executions, at the version java -jar <jar> --version reports
pom.xml has a maven-enforcer bannedDependencies rule excluding dev.fxloop compile/runtime scopes
./mvnw -q compile fxloop:prepare (or an equivalent check) succeeded
the CLAUDE.md FXLoop section gained the run-it-yourself and guard lines
the report gives ./mvnw fxloop:run, says teammates and CI need the seed line until Maven Central, and lists ~/.m2/repository/dev/fxloop/ in the undo
the MCP config was not touched and no reload was requested
